# hookbase_destination (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase webhook destination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# HTTP destination with bearer auth
resource "hookbase_destination" "api" {
  name       = "internal-api"
  slug       = "internal-api"
  url        = "https://api.internal.example.com/webhooks"
  method     = "POST"
  auth_type  = "bearer"
  auth_config = {
    token = var.internal_api_token
  }
  timeout_ms = 15000
}

# Slack notification destination
resource "hookbase_destination" "slack" {
  name = "slack-alerts"
  slug = "slack-alerts"
  url  = var.slack_webhook_url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Destination name (1-100 characters).
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `auth_config` (Map of String, Sensitive) Authentication configuration. Sensitive — API redacts this on read.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication type: none, basic, bearer, api_key, oauth2, or custom.
- `batch_size` (Number) Number of events to batch per delivery.
- `batch_window_seconds` (Number) Time window in seconds to collect events before batching.
- `config` (String, Sensitive) JSON configuration for non-HTTP destination types. Sensitive — API redacts this on read.
- `headers` (Map of String) Custom HTTP headers to include in deliveries.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the destination is active.
- `method` (String) HTTP method for delivery. Defaults to POST.
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Rate limit per minute for deliveries to this destination.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Delivery timeout in milliseconds.
- `type` (String) Destination type: http, websocket, tunnel, sqs, sns, gcp_pubsub, azure_servicebus, kafka, or rabbitmq.
- `url` (String) Destination URL to deliver webhooks to.
- `use_static_ip` (Boolean) Use a static IP for deliveries.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Destination ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
